gate.why: the independent reviewer is the one thing cost-scaling may never touch; a weaker reviewer silently weakens every verdict

ship-build.why: BUILD writes the diff the reviewer then trusts; below standard tier it produces work the gate must reject

slice.why: slice implements against a spec with no reviewer between it and the branch

debate.why: debate is a judgment task, not a lookup; a weaker model produces agreeable noise instead of an adversary

debater.why: debate is a judgment task, not a lookup; a weaker model produces agreeable noise instead of an adversary

explain-author.why: explainers verify every mechanism claim against source, which needs enough capability to read code accurately

hunt.why: correctness hunting degrades into plausible-sounding false positives below this floor

seam.why: boundary analysis needs enough capability to hold two subsystems in view at once

trace.why: tracing a data path end to end needs enough capability to keep the whole path in view

img-inspector.why: visual inspection is the only path by which figure defects reach a verdict at all

ship-gate.why: a controller that delegates the actual verdict; its own floor only has to keep the loop coherent

ship-start.why: state selection and branch setup are mechanical once the plan is chosen

sweep.why: breadth reconnaissance returns pointers for caller verification, not verdicts
